summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of AI City of Agents. All 20 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend auth, world creation, dashboard with KPIs/live event feed, sidebar navigation across all 8 pages, simulation start, and god-mode event trigger all working. Live event feed correctly displays god-mode events (festival, boom, recession) triggered via backend tests.

issues: Sidebar label says 'Relations' but page title/route is 'Relationships' - minor inconsistency

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to interactive elements (email/password inputs, Login/Register button, ENTER WORLD, START/PAUSE sim, god-mode trigger buttons, nav links) to improve automated test reliability
Consider unifying sidebar label 'Relations' with page title 'Relationships' for consistency
critical_code_review_comments: No data-testid attributes anywhere in the UI - makes E2E testing fragile (had to rely on text selectors)
server.py is 410 lines and acceptable, but consider extracting route groups into routers (auth, worlds, agents, simulation, god-mode) for maintainability if app grows
All MongoDB queries correctly exclude _id via projection - good
JWT_SECRET in backend/.env is a default placeholder - flag for production use only
seed_data_creation: Reused existing world; created TEST_World_xxxxx with 100 agents if none existed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 20 critical endpoints (auth, worlds CRUD, agents, events, relationships, businesses, stories, newspaper, analytics, simulation start/pause/speed, god-mode recession/boom/festival). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. The agent detail endpoint returns the agent object directly (not wrapped under 'agent' key) and includes 'relationships' list. Stats endpoint uses keys: population, average_happiness, average_income, approval_rating, births. Demo user already registered.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA - all features functioning correctly. AI City simulation generates events, KPIs update from backend, god-mode triggers reflect in live feed within seconds.
